title: Check yourself: Reading a trace, isolating the origin and the practice

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: In a trace, the final user entry carried a tool's output and then a line of commentary. The reply came back as `end_turn` with an empty content list. Which diagnosis fits?

options.text: The model chose to stop, so add a user message asking it to continue
options.says: Ruled out because that is the answer only when no text followed: the table gives "The model: add a new user message that asks it to continue" for "If no".

options.text: The request layout is at fault, so return the result unaccompanied
options.says: The table says that when text follows the tool result the origin is "The integration: send the tool result alone", and the routine's step 4 says "An `end_turn` with no content blocks is an empty reply. Look at the request before it."

options.text: The account reached a limit, so raise the quota before anything else
options.says: Ruled out because a limit arrives as an error: "An `error` event has one, and the table of page 1 gives its origin and recovery".

options.text: The service dropped the output, so retry the same call unchanged
options.says: Ruled out because "A dropped connection has none: it is the network, and it belongs to the service side", while here a response arrived with a stop reason.

origin.section: Integration or model: the question that decides

questions.stem: A team's code could not read this reply: "Sure! Here is the answer: {"label": "spam"} Hope it helps." What does the routine conclude?

options.text: The account lacks access to structured output, so request it
options.says: Ruled out because an access failure arrives as an error status: "An `error` event has one, and the table of page 1 gives its origin and recovery".

options.text: The model failed to produce JSON, so validate and ask it again
options.says: Ruled out because "The model: it did not produce JSON, so validate and ask again" applies only when no object is in the text, and here one is.

options.text: The service truncated the body, so retry the call with back-off
options.says: Ruled out because a cut-off arrives as a stop reason: "A refusal, a `max_tokens` stop, a context-window stop or a pause is a failure of a successful response".

options.text: The parser was too strict, so pull out the object first
options.says: The table says that an object in the text makes it "The integration: the parser was too strict, so extract the object first".

origin.section: Integration or model: the question that decides

questions.stem: A trace holds a 529, then a retry that returns a good response, then nothing else. What is the finding?

options.text: A service failure, which ended without recovery
options.says: Ruled out because "A later good response means the failure was survived", so the trace did recover.

options.text: A service failure, which the application survived
options.says: The page says "A 529 is retried and succeeds, so the application recovered", and "A later good response means the failure was survived".

options.text: A model failure, which the application survived
options.says: Ruled out because "Trace B's 529 is the service's", and a 529 is not model output.

options.text: An integration failure, which needs a fix in code
options.says: Ruled out because "a bug in your request fails the same way each time", while this request succeeded on the retry.
